chunks: A man asked Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, and said:
O son of the cousin of the best of Allah’s creation, Mighty and Majestic, what is the meaning of extending your neck in rukuʿ?
He said: “Its interpretation is: I have believed in Allah, even if my neck were to be struck.”

key_terms.آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ: I have believed in Allah; a declaration of faith
key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الرُّكُوعِ: rukuʿ, the bowing posture in salat (prayer)
key_terms.ضُرِبَتْ عُنُقِي: my neck were struck; meaning even if killed

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of extending the neck during rukuʿ in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the inner meaning of extending the neck during rukuʿ in salat (prayer). Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام describes it as a sign of unwavering iman in Allah, even in the face of death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.927 - A man asked The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) saying:
"O’ son of the cousin of the best of Allah’s (swt) creation, what is the significance of extending your neck during ruku' (bowing in prayer)?"
Imam Ali (as) responded, "It symbolizes 'I have faith in Allah (swt), even if my neck is struck.'"
